SeafoamIslands_B2F_Text_BeatenGrunt.en: A kid in a cap went through here.\nHe wiped out my whole team…\pGo on. The cap kid is ahead,\nwith a redhead.
SeafoamIslands_B2F_Text_BeatenGrunt.fr: Un gamin en casquette est passé par\nici. Il a balayé toute mon équipe…\pVas-y. Le gamin à casquette est\ndevant, avec un rouquin.

SeafoamIslands_B2F_Text_Onybris3Intro.en: The volcano is a fine hideout.\nWarm and no neighbors.
SeafoamIslands_B2F_Text_Onybris3Intro.fr: Le volcan est une belle cachette.\nChaud et sans voisins.

SeafoamIslands_B2F_Text_Onybris3Post.en: Take a gentleman's advice:\ndo not go any deeper.
SeafoamIslands_B2F_Text_Onybris3Post.fr: Écoute le conseil d'un gentleman :\nne va pas plus profond.

SeafoamIslands_B2F_Text_Onybris4Intro.en: You smell like a lawman's kid!
SeafoamIslands_B2F_Text_Onybris4Intro.fr: Tu sens le fils de flic !

SeafoamIslands_B2F_Text_Onybris4Post.en: The boss walked right past us.\nWe were told not to look.
SeafoamIslands_B2F_Text_Onybris4Post.fr: Le boss est passé juste devant\nnous. On nous a dit de pas\lregarder.
